# Al-Tooba Prophetic Remedies

> Authentic Prophetic Medicine (Tibb-e-Nabawi), pure Talbina superfoods, 100% natural herbal oils, and Sunnah remedies.

Al-Tooba Prophetic Remedies Private Limited specializes in traditional Islamic natural wellness, pure sunnah remedies, cold-pressed therapeutic oils, and dietary superfoods formulated with authentic botanical herbs.
